Before & Afters Specials Memberships Shop Online Menu of Services Book Now Current Specials Book Online Home / BioRePeel Home / BioRePeel BioRePeel At the Cosmetic Enhancement Center of New England, we pride ourselves on seeking new ways to help patients throughout Portland, Maine and our neighboring communities in New Hampshire, reach their aesthetic goals from our three convenient locations in Portland, Waterville, and Falmouth. Whether you’re looking to improve the appearance of dull or uneven skin or combat visible skin imperfections, our team of experienced providers is here to help. We are excited to add the BioRePeel to our lineup of powerful skin rejuvenation treatments! This state-of-the-art chemical peel targets a variety of skin concerns and is a gentle yet effective treatment crafted to rejuvenate your face, neck, and décolletage. On This Page What Is BioRePeel? Benefits Preparation Procedure Aftercare FAQ What Is BioRePeel? BioRePeel is a revolutionary chemical peel that leverages advanced biostimulation technology. It is engineered to stimulate collagen and elastin production to rejuvenate the skin. BioRePeel Benefits BioRePeel Benefits Revitalizing Exfoliation: BioRePeel excels in removing dead skin cells, enhancing the skin’s natural renewal process. Enhances Skin Appearance: Expect a smoother, and more luminous complexion. Improves Uneven Skin Tone: Effectively diminishes age spots and hyperpigmentation. Acne and Scar Improvement: Ideal for managing acne, scars, and post-inflammatory changes. Comfort and Convenience: Enjoy the benefits of BioRePeel without the hassles of social downtime or discomfort. Suitable Year-Round: This versatile treatment is perfect for maintaining skin health throughout the year. Stimulates Collagen and Elastin: This peel actively promotes the production of collagen and elastin to improve skin’s firmness and elasticity. Preparing For BioRePeel Preparation is key to optimizing your BioRePeel results. Adjust your skincare regimen as recommended by our licensed aestheticians, particularly making sure to avoid products with retinol. It’s also important to limit sun exposure before your treatment and stay hydrated to ensure your skin is in prime condition for the procedure. The BioRePeel Procedure Our skilled providers at the Cosmetic Enhancement Center of New England will begin by thoroughly cleansing your skin. At this time, your provider can additionally dermaplane your skin to remove any dead skin cells and peach fuzz, allowing the BioRePeel to effectively penetrate your skin. Next, the BioRePeel solution, a unique concoction of acids, amino acids, and vitamins, is then meticulously applied. You may feel a mild tingling as it begins to penetrate. After a brief period, your provider will gently remove the solution, revealing revitalized and luminous skin that will continue to improve in the ensuing weeks. Post-Treatment Care & Results Following your BioRePeel treatment, it’s crucial to avoid direct sunlight for a few days and use a high-SPF sunscreen. Keep your skin well-hydrated and avoid harsh skincare products. Mild peeling or dryness is normal and part of the rejuvenation process. Frequently Asked Questions About BioRePeel What’s the difference between BioRePeel and other chemical peels? BioRePeel distinguishes itself from traditional chemical peels with its gentler, yet effective approach. Unlike regular peels that primarily rely on peeling action, BioRePeel utilizes a patented 2-phase technology for bio-stimulating, revitalizing, and peeling-like effects without extensive downtime. Its unique formulation, featuring active agents like Trichloroacetic acid (TCA), is designed to improve skin texture and address blemishes. This advanced composition not only ensures a more comfortable experience but also sets BioRePeel apart from other peels by offering a comprehensive skin rejuvenation solution. Who is a good candidate for BioRePeel? BioRePeel is suitable for a wide range of individuals seeking to improve skin texture, tone, and appearance. It’s ideal for those with concerns like dull skin, uneven texture, fine lines, acne, and hyperpigmentation. However, it’s not recommended for those with certain skin conditions/allergies or those who are pregnant/nursing. A consultation with our experts can determine if it’s right for you. How many treatments will I need to see results? While you may notice immediate improvements, optimal results typically require multiple treatments. The exact number varies depending on your specific skin concerns and goals. During your consultation, one of our licensed aestheticians will create a personalized treatment plan for you. Are there any side effects of BioRePeel? Common side effects include mild redness, tingling, and slight swelling, which typically subside quickly. Some peeling or dryness may occur as part of the skin’s natural rejuvenation process. Our team will advise you on how to minimize and manage these effects. How long do the results of BioRePeel last? The duration of BioRePeel results varies, but typically you can expect to enjoy the benefits for several months. To maintain results, we may recommend periodic maintenance treatments along with a proper skincare regimen. Can BioRePeel be combined with other treatments? Yes, BioRePeel can be safely combined with other cosmetic treatments like Botox ® and dermal fillers or DiamondGlow ® . Combining treatments can address a wider range of skin concerns and enhance overall results. We recommend consulting with our specialists to tailor a treatment plan to your needs.
